title: Hardship Cause Share on Early-Closing Interest - Credit Builder Accounts
content:
For a Credit Builder borrower in hardship the early closure is the only relief the plan offers, so the closing interest charged at an early closing is reduced according to the cause for which the borrower's Larkspur hardship plan was granted. The plans are the borrower's Hardship Assistance Programs plans, read from the hardship plan records: each plan's status and its hardship reason.

## Cause of hardship

- When the borrower has a Larkspur hardship plan in active status granted for the death of a household earner, a natural disaster or a medical hardship, the closing interest is multiplied by the severe-cause share of 0.8, since for a Credit Builder borrower in hardship the early closure is the only relief the plan offers.
- When the borrower has none of those but has a Larkspur hardship plan in active status granted for job loss, reduced income or divorce or separation, the closing interest is multiplied by the income-cause share of 0.9.
- When the borrower has no Larkspur hardship plan in active status granted for any of those causes, the closing interest is not reduced for the cause of hardship (a share of 1.0).

The share multiplies the closing interest before it is rounded to the cent. Plans in a status other than active are not counted.

| Hardship reason of an active plan held by the borrower | Share |
|---|---|
| death of a household earner, natural disaster, or medical hardship | 0.8 |
| job loss, reduced income, or divorce or separation, and none of the three above | 0.9 |
| none of those six causes, or no active plan | no reduction |

## Questions the rule answers

**An unrounded closing interest of 10.00, and the borrower's active plan was granted for a medical hardship. What is charged?** 10.00 multiplied by 0.8, that is 8.00, before rounding.

**The active plan was granted for reduced income instead.** 10.00 multiplied by 0.9, that is 9.00.

**The borrower's only hardship plan is no longer active.** No reduction: 10.00 stays 10.00.
